title: fix(plugin-auth): ban and unban write the admin audit row; the remove-sso-user row is named in the ledger note and docs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoA1ALjVcUcAuAA15MyUocBx)_

Fixes #35440

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：平台管理员封禁或解封用户后，审计日志里多一条写明是哪位管理员操作的记录；认证文档和接口清单写明了“移除待加入人员”会留下的审计记录。
- 为什么做：管理员审计跟进项。其他管理员用户操作都会写这条记录，只有封禁和解封没有；在没装管理插件的环境里，原来的记录写的是“系统”，查不到是谁封禁的。
- 出错会怎样：审计记录写失败不影响封禁或解封本身，只会在日志里留一条警告；改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `admin/ban-user` and `admin/unban-user` now write one admin audit row for a change that committed, through the shared `writeAdminAudit` the other admin user doors use (create-user, set-user-password, add/import/remove SSO user): `action: 'update'` on the target `sys_user`, naming the administrator, with `metadata` `{ event: 'user.admin_banned' | 'user.admin_unbanned', hostNotified }`. A refused ban or unban writes no row. The ban writes themselves are unchanged (the maintainer ruling recorded in `admin-ban-endpoints.ts` stands).
- `AdminAuditDecisions` gains the two events. The ban reason and expiry are fields of the user, so they stay on plugin-audit's mirror row and are kept out of `metadata`, as that type's docblock requires.
- The route ledger note for `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/remove-sso-user` and `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` now name that door's `user.admin_removed_pending` row (action `delete`, written only on a committed removal). The ban/unban paragraph of the doc names the new rows.

## Why

Item 2 of the card asked to measure whether plugin-audit's mirror row already covers a ban. It does not:

- With the admin plugin, the ban write reaches the engine as `{ isSystem: true, attributedUserId: ADMIN_ID }`, so the mirror row names the admin. But it is a plain `update` field diff, with no event and no `hostNotified`.
- Without the admin plugin (`engineUserBanWriter`, the managed Free/Team case), the write reaches the engine as `{ isSystem: true, positions: [], permissions: [] }`, with no `attributedUserId`. So the mirror row records the ban as the system. There, no row named the administrator who banned.

Measured by a throwaway spy on `engine.update` in the shared route harness (not committed). Real route, both kernels, ban then unban:

```text
MEASURE adminPlugin=true  context {"isSystem":true,"attributedUserId":"ADMIN_ID"}  sys_audit_log rows: []
MEASURE adminPlugin=false context {"isSystem":true,"positions":[],"permissions":[]} sys_audit_log rows: []
```

That rules out an exemption, so the doors now write the row.

## Tests

The pins are in the shared route harness for these doors (`pending-sso-users.test.ts`, which already drives `admin/ban-user` / `admin/unban-user` over the real mount), in a new `[#35440]` describe:

- With the admin plugin off and on: one ban plus one unban write exactly two `update` rows. Each names the admin as `user_id` / `actor` on `sys_user` / the target, with metadata `user.admin_banned` / `user.admin_unbanned` and `hostNotified: true`.
- With no host wired, the row carries `hostNotified: false`.
- CONTROL: a host-refused ban (409), a self-ban (400) and a member-cap-refused unban (403) write no row.

<details><summary>Readings (final head 0f9dc05fa5, after merging origin/main)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: `check:test-typecheck: OK`; Test Files 287 passed (287), Tests 6070 passed | 10 skipped (6080). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The pre-merge head 64d7c506 read 287/287 files and 6053 passed.
- Ablation, on the committed fix at 64d7c506: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the ban door's `auditBan` call. The anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob from 6f0477963c20 to 1fe3fd0e2ff3. The `[#35440]` describe then went 4 of 4 red: the CONTROL's committed-ban leg asserts the row too. On restore the blob matched HEAD again (6f0477963c20) and `git diff HEAD` was empty. Plugin-auth tests import `src`, so no dist rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation from the claim's surface:** `admin/ban-user` and `admin/unban-user` have no ledger note to amend. They appear only in `BETTER_AUTH_MOUNTED_SURFACE`, the list of vendor routes the raw mount shadows, with no note string. The new rows are named in `admin-ban-endpoints.ts`'s header and in the doc instead.
- **Out of scope, reported to the seat:** without the admin plugin, the mirror row for the ban columns is still attributed to the system, because `engineUserBanWriter` passes a bare system context with no attributed user. The explicit row added here is now the trail that names the administrator. Fixing the mirror row's attribution is a change to `user-ban-write.ts`, outside this claim.
- A failed audit insert keeps the existing `writeAdminAudit` posture: it never fails the answer and logs one `warn`.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-ban-endpoints.ts`, the `auditBan` helper and its two call sites. Each call sits after the committed write (and, for a ban, after the session revocation), so no refusal path reaches it.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts`, the new `AdminAuditDecisions` member. It is closed to decisions only, with no field value of the user.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`, the `[#35440]` describe.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/pending-sso-users.test.ts -t 35440`. Expect 4 passed.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 104 families, and all 104 ran with exit 0 (`--ran`: 104 derived, 104 run, 0 UNRUN). Exit codes were captured per command before any pipe. On the pre-merge head, `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (unbuilt dist); they measured once the closure was built.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 0 anchors lost.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean (main, #35664 and #34738 merge cleanly).

</details>
